nodes.name: Ni-Mo alloy nanopowder synthesis
nodes.procedure: Unsupported Ni-Mo alloy nanopowders were prepared by McKone et al. via a slow decomposition of mixed Ni and Mo salts into mixed Ni/Mo oxides or hydroxides, and a subsequent annealing under reducing atmosphere to convert these intermediates into Ni-Mo alloys. The powders were then suspended in solvents and cast onto substrates under various loadings.

nodes.name: NiO/Ni-CNT synthesis
nodes.procedure: Nanoscale nickel oxide-nickel (NiO/Ni) interfaces created via the low-pressure decomposition and reduction of nickel hydroxide grown on top of oxidized carbon nanotubes (Ni(OH)₂/ox-CNT) upon annealing under an inert atmosphere. The ox-CNT precursors are crucial in delaying the reduction of Ni(OH)₂ into large Ni aggregates via Ostwald ripening by spatially separating the individual nanoparticles.

nodes.name: Lithium cycling for NiFeOₓ/CFP
nodes.procedure: Wang et al. have utilized a conversion reaction by lithium ion (Li⁺) insertion and extraction, employed in lithium-ion batteries, to improve the catalytic performance of transition metal oxide. The Li⁺ insertion/extraction cycling could greatly reduce the grain size of the transition metal oxide nanoparticles. The optimized 2-cycle nickel-iron oxide on carbon fiber paper (NiFeOₓ/CFP) exhibited excellent activity.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM reveals ~10 nm nanoparticles with core-shell structure (Ni core, Ni/O shell) on CNT network for NiO/Ni-CNT catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) and electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) mapping revealed ~10 nm nanoparticles with a core–shell-like structure, with Ni and O in the shell and only Ni in the core over a CNT network.

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS elemental mapping shows Ni (red), C (blue), O (green) distribution confirming core-shell structure of NiO/Ni-CNT.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Reconstructed EELS elemental maps with Ni in red, C in blue, and O in green for NiO/Ni-CNT structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows NiO shell with grains of different orientations and small gaps exposing nanoscale NiO-Ni interfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution STEM images showed that the NiO shell contains grains with different orientation and small in-between gaps, exposing many nanoscale NiO–Ni interfaces.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni XPS shows binding energies for both Ni2+ and metallic Ni in NiO/Ni-CNT catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High resolution Ni XPS spectra (the dotted line shows the binding energy of Ni2+ (red) and metallic Ni (blue)).

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EELS maps show oxidation of Ni core and NiO/Ni phase separation in NiO/Ni heterostructure after stability test.
nodes.evidence_snippet: STEM images and EELS mapping indicated obvious oxidation of the Ni core and some phase separation between NiO and Ni after long-term stability measurement.
